company.name: TrustArc
company.shortDescription: TrustArc is a privacy compliance technology company that offers software to help corporations update their privacy management processes.
company.description: TrustArc specializes in privacy compliance and data protection. They focus on building and maturing privacy programs and enabling continuous compliance, information governance, and data security. Their solutions include customer consent, preference, privacy strategy and operations, privacy insights, and managed services.

aiResearchSummary.text: TrustArc is engaged in developing a combinatorial accountability framework database system aimed at enhancing risk management and compliance. This system involves a master framework database that automates the management of risk and compliance programs, aligning with TrustArc's focus on privacy compliance technology. The framework facilitates the assessment of risk management and compliance, supporting corporations in updating their privacy management processes effectively.
